newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian court sentences son of Mafia "Godfather".
newsitem.headline: Italian court sentences son of Mafia "Godfather".

text.p: An Italian court on Saturday sentenced the 20-year-old son of jailed "boss of bosses" Salvatore Riina to four years and eight months in prison for Mafia association.

Giovanni Riina, the eldest of "Godfather" Riina's four children, had been accused of taking a leading role in Cosa Nostra following his father's arrest in January 1993 after nearly 23 years on the run.
The young Riina was arrested last July at his family's home in the Sicilian town of Corleone, which Hollywood immortalised in the Godfather movies.
Judicial sources had said his arrest was part of a probe into the 1995 murder of Antonio Di Caro, whom the Corleonese clan had suspected of leaking information to the police.

Di Caro's body was dissolved in a tub of acid, according to testimony of Mafia turncoats who also alleged that Giovanni was schooled in the ways of the Mob by his father, who has received 11 life prison sentences.

One turncoat, Tullio Cannella, has alleged that Giovanni was in close contact with Giovanni Brusca, one of Italy's most wanted Mafia fugitives until his capture last June. Giovanni Riina has denied knowing Brusca.
